name: business-skills
description: Evidence-first business decision skills for AI agents.

interface.shortDescription: Rigorous business judgment for AI agents.
interface.longDescription: Open, testable workflows for strategy, markets, forecasting, and business decisions—built to expose uncertainty rather than manufacture confidence.
defaultPrompt: $horizon-scout Scan an emerging market and produce falsifiable, calibrated hypotheses.
$evidence-echo-forensics Trace this claim to its independent evidence origins and test whether the apparent consensus survives.
$autonomy-governor Compile this AI-agent workflow into a testable authority contract with limits, approvals, enforcement, rollback, and stop conditions.
